Start/resume the McKernel milestone goal through the local Codex app server.
No model calls for --dry-run, --status, --check or --check-sudo. A normal
invocation starts paid/account-metered work. Runtime state stays in the
repository's Git directory.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dry-run             Print launch settings; no server, thread or model call
  --check               Inspect local Codex settings/models; no thread or
                        inference
  --check-sudo          Verify private askpass authentication with sudo id -u;
                        no inference
  --status              Read the last saved launcher snapshot; no server
  --progress            Show live runner activity and the last engineering
                        dashboard; no server
  --instruct TEXT       Send a live instruction to the coordinator; queues
                        through checkpoints
  --capture-progress-directory CAPTURE_PROGRESS_DIRECTORY
                        Explicit fresh capture directory; with --instruct
                        register it before steering, otherwise at startup
  --hours HOURS         Optional work window in hours; 0 means no time limit
                        (default: 0)

                        Dispatcher model; default: gpt-6.1-sol
  --effort {low,medium,high}

                        Dedicated-machine parallelism (default) or historical

  --max-agents MAX_AGENTS

                        balanced

  --memory-gib MEMORY_GIB
